Treatment summary
The patient presented following a sideswipe clolision that occurred while the other vehicle moved into their lane during a lane
change. Reported left knee pain and swelling are consistent with the mechanism of this type of impact. Over the course of fifteen
visits, care followed a conventional progression of physical examination, imaging review, targeted physical therapy, and home
exercise instruction. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved and range of motion returned. Several
examination findings, including localized tenderness and a modest effusion, support an acute soft tissue injury to the knee. Other
ligament and meniscal stability tests were within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, minor strain in the same region
years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation and does not appear to account for the present complaints. Billed
services correspond to the visits documented, with no duplicated or repeated charges identified in the record.

"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
